I read Inbox + Help Center so signals surface automatically. I draft; you approve.

useCases.title: Pull the full timeline for one account
useCases.blurb: Sign-up to today — tickets, bugs, asks, ships, health.
useCases.prompt: Show me the full timeline for {customer}.
useCases.fullPrompt: Build the full customer timeline for {customer}. Use the customer-timeline skill. Read ../inbox/customers.json and ../inbox/conversations/ for every interaction, ../inbox/bug-candidates.json for bugs they've hit, ../help-center/requests.json for features they've asked for, ../help-center/shipped-log.json for anything that shipped since. Pull billing state from Stripe via Composio if connected. Synthesize a chronological timeline at accounts/{slug}/timeline.md with: sign-up, key tickets with resolution, bugs filed, features requested (with ship status), churn flags fired, health-score history. End with: 'What the account looks like today' — 3 sentences. Log in outputs.json.
useCases.description: Aggregates Inbox conversations, bug candidates, Help Center feature requests + ships, and Stripe billing state into one chronological timeline per account.
useCases.outcome: A timeline at accounts/{slug}/timeline.md — required reading before I draft renewals, saves, or QBR prep for that account.

useCases.title: Score account health — GREEN / YELLOW / RED
useCases.blurb: One score, three signals, one recommended action.
useCases.fullPrompt: Score account health for {customer}. Use the score-account-health skill. Read the customer's timeline (run customer-timeline first if missing), then evaluate signals: support volume trend (Inbox), unresolved bugs affecting them, unmet feature requests, churn-flag status, last-seen if available via Composio usage analytics, billing state via Stripe. Output GREEN / YELLOW / RED with: the 3 signals driving the score, one paragraph of reasoning, and ONE recommended next action (write, nudge, escalate, leave alone). Save to accounts/{slug}/health-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md, update health-scores.json index, log in outputs.json.
useCases.description: Traffic-light score per account from support volume, bug count, unmet asks, churn flags, usage (if connected), billing state. Outputs GREEN / YELLOW / RED + one recommended action.
useCases.outcome: A score at accounts/{slug}/health-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md + updated health-scores.json. Feeds the weekly review.

useCases.title: Draft onboarding sequence for new signups
useCases.blurb: Day 0/1/3/7/14 drips with CTA + success metric.
useCases.prompt: Draft the onboarding sequence for new {segment} signups.
useCases.fullPrompt: Draft a 5-touch onboarding sequence for new {segment} signups (or a specific new customer if you name them). Use the draft-onboarding-sequence skill. Read ../head-of-support/support-context.md for product surface + voice, and the segment's profile if we have one. Draft Day 0 (welcome), Day 1 (first-value nudge), Day 3 (milestone check), Day 7 (feedback ask), Day 14 (activation review). For each: subject, body, CTA, and what we'd consider success for that touch. Save to onboarding/{slug}.md, log in outputs.json. Draft only — I never send.
useCases.description: Day 0 / 1 / 3 / 7 / 14 drip — welcome, first-value nudge, milestone check, feedback ask, activation review. Each touch has a CTA and a success metric.
useCases.outcome: A sequence at onboarding/{slug}.md ready to paste into your outbound tool or schedule via lifecycle.

useCases.title: Draft 30/60/90 renewal outreach
useCases.blurb: Pre-renewal touches grounded in their timeline.
useCases.prompt: Draft renewal outreach for {account} — renewal is in {date}.
useCases.fullPrompt: Draft renewal outreach for {account}, renewal date {date}. Use the draft-renewal-outreach skill. Pull the account's timeline (run customer-timeline first if missing) and the current health score. Draft 3 touches: Day-90 (ROI reminder, ship highlights since last renewal, ask for a check-in), Day-60 (address known friction — any RED health signals, open bugs affecting them, unmet feature asks now shipped), Day-30 (direct ask for the conversation, propose a 20-min call with 2 agenda bullets). Voice pulls from support-context.md. Save to renewals/{slug}.md, log in outputs.json. Draft only.
useCases.description: 3-touch pre-renewal sequence (Day-90 / Day-60 / Day-30) grounded in the account timeline, health score, open items, and what's shipped that they asked for.
useCases.outcome: A sequence at renewals/{slug}.md. Paste into your outbound tool after you approve.

useCases.title: Draft a churn-save for an at-risk account
useCases.blurb: Acknowledge, name the pain, offer the real next step.
useCases.prompt: Draft a churn-save for {account} — they just flagged for downgrade.
useCases.fullPrompt: Draft a churn-save for {account}. Use the draft-churn-save skill. Pull the account's timeline + health score. Read ../inbox/churn-flags.json for the signal that fired and ../inbox/conversations/ for the underlying messages. Draft ONE message (not a sequence): acknowledge the signal honestly, name the specific pain you see from their history (open bugs? unmet asks? silence?), offer the real next step — a 15-min call, a specific fix, a price concession (flag for my approval, never propose without me saying so). Voice pulls from support-context.md. Save to saves/{slug}.md, log in outputs.json. Draft only.
useCases.description: Single save message grounded in the specific reason the account is at risk — acknowledge, name the pain from history, offer the real next step. Never proposes pricing concessions without approval.
useCases.outcome: A save draft at saves/{slug}.md. Approve and send.

useCases.title: Prep a QBR for a customer check-in
useCases.blurb: What they've gotten, what they asked for, what's next.
useCases.prompt: Prep a QBR for {account} — meeting on {date}.
useCases.fullPrompt: Prep a QBR for {account}, meeting on {date}. Use the prep-qbr skill. Pull the account's timeline + latest health score. Draft a QBR outline: (1) What they've gotten — usage/outcome highlights, (2) What they asked for and what shipped, (3) Where they're stuck — open bugs, unmet asks, friction, (4) What we're proposing next — 2–3 concrete moves we'd like their input on. Voice pulls from support-context.md. Save to qbrs/{slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md, log in outputs.json.
useCases.description: Four-section QBR outline — wins, asks-shipped, friction, proposed next moves. Grounded in the account timeline so nothing's generic.
useCases.outcome: A QBR outline at qbrs/{slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md. Convert to slides or read straight off the doc.

useCases.title: Draft an expansion nudge
useCases.blurb: They're hitting the ceiling — open the conversation.
useCases.prompt: Draft an expansion nudge for {account} — they're hitting the ceiling on plan {tier}.
useCases.fullPrompt: Draft an expansion nudge for {account}. Use the nudge-expansion skill. Pull the account's timeline + health score. Look for ceiling signals: usage near plan limit (via Composio usage analytics if connected), support tickets about limits, asks for features only available on higher plans, new team members added. Draft ONE short message: acknowledge the specific signal, name the higher-plan feature that would help them, offer a 15-min conversation — not a close. Voice pulls from support-context.md. Save to expansion/{slug}.md, log in outputs.json. Draft only.
useCases.description: Single expansion outreach grounded in a specific ceiling signal (usage near limit, feature request on higher tier, team growth). Opens a conversation, doesn't push a close.
useCases.outcome: A nudge at expansion/{slug}.md. Approve and send.
